verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native 'export everything' feature. The only path out is the REST API, which can read nearly everything in a workspace (pages, databases, users, comments), with an OpenAPI spec and personal access tokens for scripts. That means a user could build their own full extraction, but Notion offers no turnkey export. One community user also reports it is 'hard to get stuff out of it,' and another notes data is tied to Notion's cloud. Missing for 10: a documented first-party full-workspace export, open file formats (e.g. Markdown/HTML/CSV) for exports, guidance on export completeness and fidelity, and independent confirmation that a full exit works.
